name: London System
description: A simple d4 setup course that teaches the default London structure first, then common Black reactions.

branches.title: Main Line: London Setup
branches.description: Learn the basic London starting pattern.

moves.title: Start with d4
moves.explanation: Controls e5 and c5, opens the c1 bishop, and gives White a stable central base. d4 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. After the London setup, keep the dark-square bishop active, castle, and aim for steady central pressure rather than a rushed attack.

moves.title: Black mirrors
moves.explanation: Black also takes central space. The position is stable enough for a setup approach. d5 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. After the London setup, keep the dark-square bishop active, castle, and aim for steady central pressure rather than a rushed attack.

moves.title: Develop bishop outside
moves.explanation: Bf4 develops the bishop before e3 can block it. This is the key London habit. Bf4 develops a bishop to f4. Developed pieces control central squares, help castling, and make future tactics possible without forcing anything too early.
